title: Juniper and the Songbook
author: Ivo Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Reyes, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
